image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a custom automotive wheel assembly. The wheel features a five-spoke alloy rim with a brushed silver finish on the face and a glossy red interior/barrel. The center cap displays a yellow shield logo resembling the Ferrari prancing horse emblem. A black rubber tire is mounted on the rim, showing visible tread blocks and sidewall texture. The background includes a glimpse of red car bodywork at the top right and asphalt ground at the bottom left.
